(function() {
  var stylesLoaded = false;
  var windowLoaded = false;
  var observerOptions = {
    childList: false,
    attributes: true,
    subtree: false,
    attributeFilter: ["src"],
    attributeOldValue: true
  }

  function loadRealIframeSrc(iframe) {
    iframe.src = iframe.getAttribute("nitro-og-src");
  }

  function observeIframe(iframe) {
    var observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations, observer) {
      mutations.forEach(mutation => {
        var ogSrc = iframe.getAttribute("nitro-og-src");
        var srcDiff = iframe.src.replace(mutation.oldValue, "");
        if (iframe.src.indexOf("data:") === 0 && ["?", "&"].indexOf(srcDiff.substr(0, 1)) > -1) {// query param was added - remove it
          if (ogSrc.indexOf("?") > -1) {
            iframe.setAttribute("nitro-og-src", ogSrc + "&" + srcDiff.substr(1));
          } else {
            iframe.setAttribute("nitro-og-src", ogSrc + "?" + srcDiff.substr(1));
          }
          observer.disconnect();
          iframe.src = mutation.oldValue;
          observer.observe(iframe, observerOptions);
        }
      });
    });
    observer.observe(iframe, observerOptions);
  }

  window.addEventListener("NitroStylesLoaded", function() {
    stylesLoaded = true;
  });

  window.addEventListener("load", function() {
    windowLoaded = true;
  });

  window.addEventListener("message", function(e) {
    if (e.data.action && e.data.action === "playBtnClicked") {
      var iframes = document.getElementsByTagName('iframe');

      for(var i = 0; i < iframes.length; i++) {
        if(e.source === iframes[i].contentWindow) {
          loadRealIframeSrc(iframes[i]);
        }
      }
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('lazybeforeunveil', function(e) {
    var bg = e.target.getAttribute('nitro-lazy-bg');
    if (bg) {
      e.target.style.backgroundImage = 'url(' + bg.replace(/\(/g, '%28').replace(/\)/g, '%29') + ')';
    }

    var elementorInvis = e.target.className.indexOf('elementor-invisible') != -1;
    if (elementorInvis) {
      if (stylesLoaded) {
        e.target.className = e.target.className.replace('elementor-invisible', '');
      } else {
        window.addEventListener("NitroStylesLoaded", (function(el) {
          return function() {
            el.className = el.className.replace('elementor-invisible', '');
          };
        })(e.target));
      }
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("iframe[nitro-og-src]").forEach(observeIframe);
})();
